definitions.explanation: A security inspection of passengers and their belongings, typically at airports before boarding, to ensure safety. Also used for security inspections at other facilities.

examples.japanese: {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: I passed through the security check.

examples.japanese: {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}{場|じょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混雑|こんざつ}していた→混雑する：25387_konzatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The security screening area was crowded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧1{時間前|じかんまえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{保安検査|ほあんけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませて→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please complete the security screening at least one hour before departure.

notes:
Most commonly used in the context of airport security screening. At Japanese airports, signs and announcements use {保安検査|ほあんけんさ} as the standard term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}{場|じょう} — security screening area
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to undergo a security check
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済む：01950_sumu⟧ — to complete security screening
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧ — security screening cutoff time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手荷物検査|てにもつけんさ} — baggage inspection
- {身体検査|しんたいけんさ} — body search, physical examination
- ⟦セキュリティ→セキュリティ：04867_sekyuriti⟧⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧ — security check (loanword, less formal)
